series_start_reason: The Q3 2021 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1121404/000112140421000017/pressreleaseq32021english.htm) reports the U.S. approval and launch but its tables have no Nexviazyme row. The Q4 2021 release is the first to print a row (Q4 2021 = 15, full year 2021 = 17), so the series starts with 2021Q4. The earlier part of 2021 is not printed as a quarter and is not derived (the full-year figure less the fourth quarter is rounded to a whole million).
moa: Recombinant human acid alpha-glucosidase enzyme replacement therapy with enhanced mannose-6-phosphate content

approval_evidence.quote: NEXVIAZYME (avalglucosidase alfa-ngpt) for injection, for intravenous use ... Initial U.S. Approval: 2021

launch_evidence: Q3 2021 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1121404/000112140421000017/pressreleaseq32021english.htm): 'the U.S. approval and launch of Nexviazyme in Pompe disease'
notes: Scope: worldwide net sales in EUR as Sanofi prints them, brand total. The label reads 'Nexviazyme' in the 2021Q4-2022Q2 releases, 'Nexviazyme /Nexviadyme' from 2022Q3 to 2023Q3 and 'Nexviazyme/Nexviadyme' from 2023Q4; the row_label of each row is the label that release prints. Sanofi reports the Pompe franchise (Nexviazyme/Nexviadyme plus Myozyme/Lumizyme) separately; this series is the Nexviazyme line only. Full-year sums match the Q4 releases for 2022-2025.
search_log: reused the list of Sanofi (CIK 0001121404) quarterly-results releases 2011Q2-2026Q2 (one exhibit per quarter, 61 releases) already established for sanofi_fabrazyme (urls from seed/gold/source_manifests/sanofi_fabrazyme_quarterly.csv), re-fetched every one of the 61 from sec.gov Archives and parsed every table row (bs4) whose first cell starts with the product name

for each release took the product's row from the first table headed 'Net sales (€ million)' (worldwide, one row per product; 2011-2015 headers read '(millions of euros) / Q2 2011 net sales' or '€ million'), quarter figure first, then the H1 / 9M / FY / YTD column where printed; where a product has no row in that table (see below) used the Total Sales column of the appendix table of net sales by region

checked for every full year in which all four quarters are in the series that the four quarters equal the full-year figure printed in the Q4 release; all matched exactly (see notes where the series starts or ends mid-year)
Bigdata.com was not used; the releases were located from the existing Sanofi manifest and read directly
Nexviazyme row absent from every release before 2021Q4 (2021Q3 mentions the approval and launch in prose only); present in 2021Q4-2026Q2 (19 consecutive releases)
2021Q4 row prints '15 | ns | 17 | ns' (Q4 and full-year columns); the Q3 2021 release and the earlier releases were checked for a quarterly Nexviazyme figure and print none
FDA: Drugs@FDA BLA 761194 original label (2021) prints 'Initial U.S. Approval: 2021'; approval 2021-08-06 per the Drugs@FDA submission record
